desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT and defence-analyst accounts were focused on Iranian rejection of U.S./Qatari diplomatic proposals, Israel’s post-election political deadlock, and a reported U.S.-Russia agreement on Ukraine peace talks excluding Europe. The single most important thread is Iran’s stance on negotiations amid ongoing regional strikes.

## MAIN THREADS

### Iran Diplomacy
- @sentdefender reported that a senior Iranian official told Reuters the Qatari-presented proposals were “unacceptable ideas and not an offer,” with Iran refusing concessions until sanctions are lifted. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115460143328502149)
- @sentdefender noted Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi still claimed devotion to a diplomatic solution, aligning with earlier Reuters reporting on a possible 7-day implementation timeline. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115502880287346759)

### Israeli Politics
- @BarakRavid stated he spoke with Trump today and was not impressed by any “vision,” correcting a headline. [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2115486160659087795)
- @BarakRavid reported Israel faces weeks of political wrangling after a deadlocked election. [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2115468025931698500)
- @sentdefender covered Defense Minister Israel Katz’s criticism of opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot for urging IDF officials not to follow Netanyahu’s politicized security decisions. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115470167442374970)

### Russia-Ukraine Talks
- @Osinttechnical posted that Kremlin aide Ushakov said the U.S. and Russia have agreed to hold Ukraine peace talks without European involvement. [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2115449420636414136)

### Brazilian Politics
- @sentdefender reported Flavio Bolsonaro arrived in Miami after losing Brazil’s election, with his passport restricted and a U.S. visa reportedly provided. [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115446245540159806)

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- Iranian Foreign Minister’s statement corroborates a 7-day early implementation timeline (unconfirmed). [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2115502880287346759)
- Netanyahu is not interested in a unity government (unconfirmed). [@BarakRavid](https://x.com/BarakRavid/status/2115428525058482373)

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching whether Iran’s rejection leads to further strikes or renewed talks next week. Israeli coalition talks and any follow-up on the reported U.S.-Russia Ukraine agreement are also on the radar.
